def: to recline (as a corpse or at a meal)
kjv: guest, lean, lie, sit (down, at meat), at the table

words.word: to them that were set down

occurrences.text: And it came to pass, as Jesus sat at meat in the house, behold, many publicans and sinners came and sat down with him and his disciples.
And when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man which had not on a wedding garment:
Now when the even was come, he sat down with the twelve.
And as they sat and did eat, Jesus said, Verily I say unto you, One of you which eateth with me shall betray me.
Afterward he appeared unto the eleven as they sat at meat, and upbraided them with their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they believed not them which had seen him after he was risen.
And, behold, a woman in the city, which was a sinner, when she knew that Jesus sat at meat in the Pharisee’s house, brought an alabaster box of ointment,
For whether is greater, he that sitteth at meat, or he that serveth? is not he that sitteth at meat? but I am among you as he that serveth.
And Jesus took the loaves; and when he had given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to them that were set down; and likewise of the fishes as much as they would.
words: to them that were set down

occurrences.text: Now there was leaning on Jesus’ bosom one of his disciples, whom Jesus loved.
Now no man at the table knew for what intent he spake this unto him.
